title: MEGA65 Core Release Package (mega65r6) no ROM
description:
The latest, STABLE, and thoroughly tested version of the core for your MEGA65 R6 machine.

NOTE: This download does not contain the ROM. If you are looking for a download package containing the rom also (and are a registered filehost user), visit this private link instead:
  - https://files.mega65.org?id=5fddec06-abc1-46a8-8990-342c8d84e11f

This contains all the files needed for using the MEGA65 in one package:
 - Core (in all three formats)
 - FREEZER (aka SD Card Files)

Target: MEGA65 R6 - MEGA65 R6 (Artix A7 200T FPGA)

Note: also contains a core for the mega65r5 beta PCB

Please read the README.md for more information.
author: MEGA65
